title: [Request] Gemini API Integration with Grounding
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

Hi LobeHub Team,

Please integrate the Google Gemini API with grounding (using Google Search) enabled.  This will allow LobeHub models to leverage real-time information for improved accuracy and relevance.  See the documentation for details: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/grounding

Thanks,
ShinChven

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

Integrate the Google Gemini API, enabling the `grounding` parameter (using Google Search) as documented here: [https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/grounding](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/grounding).  A simple toggle or dedicated "Grounded Gemini" model type in LobeHub would be ideal.  Include a way to display grounding sources for transparency.


### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_
